items.title: AUKUS trip in chaos as British minister resigns hours before meeting Australians
items.description: Defence Minister Richard Marles's visit to the United Kingdom takes an awkward turn, after his British counterpart John Healey resigns hours before they were due to speak together.

items.title: Live: Iran signals caution as Trump claims war could end 'this weekend'
items.description: Iran says a final decision has not yet been made on a possible peace agreement with the US, after Donald Trump claimed one could be signed this weekend. Follow live.

items.title: How One Nation could disrupt Australia's progressive stronghold
items.description: The idea that One Nation could come close to the government benches was absurd six months ago, but it is a prospect Victorian Labor MPs and insiders are increasingly discussing.

items.title: Live: South Korea kicks off against Czechia after dramatic World Cup opener
items.description: The 2026 FIFA World Cup gets underway at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City, with the opening ceremony followed by the hosts, Mexico taking on South Africa in the opening game. Follow live.

items.title: Live: NDIS inquiry told 240,000 people to be 'exited' from scheme
items.description: A Senate inquiry into the government's National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) changes has been told 240,000 people will be "exited" from the scheme. Follow live.

items.title: 'Broken promise' or not, Albanese's tax decision helps One Nation
items.description: The prime minister's cavalier breaking of election promises has poured kerosene on the fire under a party that can no longer be called "minor".

items.title: Australian sprinter Jemma Stapleton dies on overseas family holiday
items.description: The Australian athletics world is in mourning after the death of the 25-year-old Stawell Gift finalist.

items.title: Notorious childcare paedophile loses appeal against 27-year sentence
items.description: The former childcare worker sexually abused dozens of children at centres for almost two decades.

items.title: Government agencies fail first hurdle under AI self-reporting policy
items.description: The ABC can reveal dozens of federal agencies missed mandatory deadlines to disclose how they are currently using AI.

items.title: Air India crash plunged victims' families 'into darkness'
items.description: One year on from the fatal Air India crash that claimed 260 lives, families of victims are still waiting for a report into the investigation.

items.title: Amex ordered to compensate man whose ex accessed his data
items.description: Australia's privacy commissioner has threatened a complainant with legal action to prevent the full disclosure of the findings of a long-running investigation into American Express's information security, which found widespread technology failures.

items.title: Yasinta vanished after backing an Indonesian project she once opposed
items.description: A key Indigenous leader in West Papua appeared in a documentary criticising an Indonesian government program, but then changed sides and disappeared. Her family suspects foul play.

items.title: More couples opt for micro-weddings and elopements amid cost-of-living crisis
items.description: Melbourne couple Averill and Lloyd Johnson pulled off their dream wedding for just $3,000, compared to the average wedding cost of about $38,000.

items.title: How you and your superannuation came to be aboard SpaceX
items.description: If your superannuation is managed by any of Australia's big superannuation funds, chances are you're about to become a highly valued financial backer to Elon Musk.

items.title: 'Priceless' pieces of Cartier jewellery on display at Melbourne's NGV
items.description: Glittering tiaras and dazzling necklaces worn by Hollywood icons such as Elizabeth Taylor and Grace Kelly are featured in an exhibition at the National Gallery of Victoria in Melbourne.

items.title: What are the rules around using fire pits at home?
items.description: There are rules when it comes to using fire pits and things to be cautious about, including open-air fires being a nuisance to your neighbours.

items.title: Roxane Gay and Channing Tatum join forces thanks to this Australian
items.description: It's possible the ball may not have got rolling on Roxane Gay and Channing Tatum's upcoming novel if it wasn't for an Australian connection. Gay will appear at Vivid Sydney in a wide-ranging discussion.

items.title: Picturesque cliff made famous by K-pop star to reopen
items.description: Lincolns Rock shut after crowds flocked to the site to recreate a photo posted on Instagram of a K-pop star dangling her legs off the sandstone cliff.

items.title: Mechanism that makes Venus flytraps snap uncovered, study claims
items.description: Physicists think they have found the cellular mechanism behind a Venus flytrap's signature move, but plant scientists say the mystery isn't solved yet.

items.title: US forecasters say potentially record-breaking El Niño underway
items.description: There is a high chance this year's Pacific climate phenomenon will be among the strongest on record, which could lead to hotter temperatures across the globe.

items.title: Study reveals complex links between social media use and teen wellbeing
items.description: A decade-long study following almost 1,200 Melbourne school students finds a "small increased risk" of depressive symptoms for teenagers using social media at least two hours a day.

items.title: Live: ASX opens strongly after Wall Street rebounds
items.description: The ASX opens strongly on the back of Wall Street rally and oil prices tumble. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Friday news quiz: Fake weather, a whale graveyard and James Bond going woke
items.description: Don't let your confidence be shaken or stirred by this week's test of how much you've been paying attention.

items.title: Driver spends $160 rego rebate on pothole-blown tyre
items.description: Motorists in Victoria's south-west say they are spending their car rego rebate on blown tyres following damage caused by potholes.

items.title: Sydney woman's remains found eight years after alleged murder
items.description: Nadire Sensoy disappeared from Sydney's west in 2018, with her disappearance triggering a police reward and coronial inquest.
